intro: Each template is a ready-made style for a product photo or short video, shown with an example so you know what to expect. Choose one that fits your product and where you'll post it, like a close-up detail shot for Amazon or a drink pour for TikTok. faq.q: How do I choose a template for my product?
faq.a: Choose by the buyer moment you need: a white background for a listing, lifestyle for context, a demo for use, or a creator-style ad with an AI-generated person.

faq.q: Do photo and video templates start from the same product photo?
faq.a: Yes. Both template types take one clear product photo; photo templates return a square image and video templates return 9:16, 1:1 or 16:9 clips of 6, 10 or 15 seconds.

faq.q: How do I adapt a template to my item?
faq.a: Upload a sharp product photo and describe the action, setting and crop you need. The template sets the starting composition; review each result for product drift.

faq.q: Can I add an offer after downloading a template?
faq.a: Yes. Download the result, then add your approved headline, price or offer in your own editor before publishing.

faq.q: Can I use the same setting for every team member's headshot?
faq.a: Yes. Have each person upload a recent photo and keep one setting description for everyone, so the Team Headshots results match across your About page.

faq.q: Are the results usable in paid ads?
faq.a: The generated image or video is yours to use, including paid placements. Add your own caption, price and call to action after download, since those are not baked into the result.

faq.q: How do I find templates sized for TikTok, Reels or Amazon?
faq.a: Use the platform filters to narrow the list, then check the frame label on each card: vertical clips suit TikTok and Reels, while square photos suit Amazon and product pages.
